rubrics.justification: No image was available, but the morphology description accurately reflects the provided Gardner 3AA data, including expansion, ICM, TE, and zona thinning. It cannot be considered fully image-matched because no visual assessment was possible.

The response thoroughly integrates age, ovarian response, FSH, BMI, diagnosis, sperm parameters, prior IVF failures/miscarriages, smoking, and especially thin endometrium with embryo quality and prognosis.

The reasoning is generally logical and well structured, with the thin endometrium appropriately emphasized as a major limiting factor. Minor overreach includes attributing prior failures primarily to endometrial factors and using somewhat speculative percentage adjustments.

Core points are aligned, especially regarding good prognosis from young age and concern about a 5 mm lining. However, several recommendations are weakly evidence-based or not routinely guideline-supported (ERA in this context, immunologic panels/NK testing, broad thrombophilia workup, routine PGT-A in a 26-year-old, G-CSF/PRP/stem cell suggestions).

Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer deferral, lining optimization, and uterine evaluation. It is practical overall, though some suggested interventions are more experimental than standard and should have been framed with more caution.
